theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  have sw : ∀ {x y}, Join ParallelReduction x y → Join ParallelReduction y x := by
    intro x y h; exact Exists.imp (fun _ h => h.symm) h
  have hI : ∀ {x y}, ParallelReduction (I ⬝ x) y → Join ParallelReduction y x := by
    intro x y h
    cases h with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .red_I _, .refl _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb => exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
  have hK : ∀ {x y z}, ParallelReduction (K ⬝ x ⬝ y) z → Join ParallelReduction z x := by
    intro x y z h
    cases h with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, .refl _⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      let ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := Ka_irreducible x _ ha
      exact ⟨_, he ▸ .red_K _ _, hu⟩
  have hS : ∀ {x y z w}, ParallelReduction (S ⬝ x ⬝ y ⬝ z) w →
      Join ParallelReduction w (x ⬝ z ⬝ (y ⬝ z)) := by
    intro x y z w h
    cases h with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .refl _⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      let ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he⟩ := Sab_irreducible x y _ ha
      exact ⟨_, he ▸ .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb)⟩
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | red_I => exact sw (hI h₂)
  | red_K => exact sw (hK h₂)
  | red_S => exact sw (hS h₂)
  | par ha hb => cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | red_I => exact hI (.par ha hb)
    | red_K => exact hK (.par ha hb)
    | red_S => exact hS (.par ha hb)
    | par ha' hb' =>
      let ⟨p, x, y⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      let ⟨q, u, v⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par x u, .par y v⟩
